instructions: Read transactions.csv, which contains transaction-level sales; negative amounts are refunds and must remain negative. First sum net sales by date and product, then sort dates chronologically and compute a separate cumulative sum over dates for each product. Plot one line per product using those cumulative totals. Label the axes 'Date' and 'Cumulative net sales ($)', include a legend, and title the chart 'Cumulative Net Sales by Product'. Save the figure as figure.png.
